# RM brief — 4 CORNWALL GARDENS LIMITED (09916122)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-01 — Late filing of annual accounts; CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts; CON-06 — Stale financial information  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- 4 CORNWALL GARDENS LIMITED (company number 09916122) is an active private limited company incorporated on 15 December 2015, roughly 10 years and 9 months ago, with a SIC code of 98000 and three active officers out of nine ever appointed, none appointed in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- No charges are registered against the company at any time, so it holds a clean security position and a first-charge facility could in principle be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct is mostly timely, but accounts for the year to 31 December 2022 were filed on 11 December 2023, 74 days after the statutory deadline; the most recent filing on 24 September 2025 was four days early. `[AA filed 2023-12-11; AA filed 2025-09-24; AA filed 2021-01-17]`
- That 74-day delay falls under CON-01, which treats accounts filed more than 30 days late in the past three years as a sign of weak administrative control and requires a referral with the delay stated. `[CON-01; AA filed 2023-12-11]`
- The latest accounts are micro-entity accounts, which under CON-04 do not disclose turnover or profit and are insufficient on their own to assess serviceability — management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before any decision. `[CON-04; AA filed 2025-09-24; profile]`
- Under CON-06, the most recent accounts are made up to 31 December 2024, 21 months before the assessment date of 30 September 2026, so the financial position on record is no longer current. `[CON-06; computed; profile]`
- On approach, the security position is clean and accounts are not overdue (next accounts due 30 September 2026), so the referral turns on obtaining up-to-date management information and explaining the 2023 late filing. `[profile; SEC-02; CON-01; CON-04; CON-06]`
